instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Plan a trip: list everything still open across its schedule, packing list and bookings in the order to deal with it, with the one thing to do first and a count of open things per lane", and give it policy (priority_order: priority names, most urgent first, last = closed.); lanes (The trip's lanes in the order same-priority things should come).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:rank-open-trip-things and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give the trip's lanes, each a list of rows (id, title, status, and optionally kind, group, day_order, day_date, starts_at, ends_at), and the person's policy: priority_order (the priority names, most urgent first, the last one meaning closed) and, for each lane, default_priority, priority_by_status (which status has which priority) and sort_by (the row fields that order things of the same priority, for example day_order then starts_at).
